queries.name: columns
queries.sql: SELECT table_schema,table_name,column_name,data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema NOT IN ('information_schema','pg_catalog') AND (table_name=ANY(%s) OR table_name ~* %s OR column_name ~* %s) ORDER BY table_schema,table_name,ordinal_position LIMIT 5001

queries.name: additional_columns
queries.sql: SELECT table_schema,table_name,column_name,data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE (table_schema='stock_selector' AND table_name=ANY(%s)) OR (table_schema='public' AND table_name=ANY(%s)) ORDER BY table_schema,table_name,ordinal_position LIMIT 501

queries.name: lifecycles
queries.sql: SELECT symbol,variety,exchange,listing_date,last_trade_date,created_at,updated_at FROM public.futures_contracts_all WHERE symbol=ANY(%s) ORDER BY symbol LIMIT 301

queries.name: contract_info
queries.sql: WITH wanted AS (SELECT * FROM unnest(%s::text[],%s::text[]) AS w(exchange,contract)) SELECT w.exchange AS requested_exchange,w.contract AS requested_contract,t.* FROM wanted w JOIN LATERAL (SELECT "交易日期","合约代码","交易所代码","品种代码","合约乘数","最小价格","最后日期","多头保证金率","空头保证金率","手续费收取方式","开仓手续费","平仓手续费","日内开仓手续费","日内平仓手续费","交割月下单整手数",updated_at,dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY "交易日期" DESC) AS date_rank FROM public.futures_contract_info WHERE "交易所代码"=w.exchange AND "合约代码"=ANY(ARRAY[w.contract,lower(w.contract)]) AND "交易日期"<=%s::date) t ON t.date_rank=1 ORDER BY w.exchange,w.contract LIMIT 1001

queries.name: czce_units
queries.sql: WITH x AS (SELECT publication_date,source_fetched_at,contract_id,contract_multiplier,multiplier_unit,minimum_price_tick,price_tick_unit,minimum_tick_value,tick_value_unit,currency,listed_date,last_trade_date,expiry_at,source_url,source_sha256,dense_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY contract_id ORDER BY publication_date DESC) AS date_rank FROM exchange_data.czce_futures_reference_record_latest WHERE contract_id=ANY(%s) AND publication_date<=%s::date) SELECT * FROM x WHERE date_rank=1 ORDER BY contract_id LIMIT 101

queries.name: settlement_rules
queries.sql: WITH wanted AS (SELECT * FROM unnest(%s::text[],%s::text[]) AS w(exchange,contract)) SELECT w.exchange AS requested_exchange,w.contract AS requested_contract,t.* FROM wanted w JOIN LATERAL (SELECT exchange,trade_date,contract_id,product_id,open_fee,offset_fee,short_open_fee,short_offset_fee,fee_style,fee_scale,spec_buy_rate,spec_sell_rate,source_url,source_sha256,fetched_at,dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY trade_date DESC) AS date_rank FROM exchange_data.futures_settle_param WHERE exchange=w.exchange AND contract_id=ANY(ARRAY[w.contract,lower(w.contract)]) AND trade_date<=%s::date) t ON t.date_rank=1 ORDER BY w.exchange,w.contract LIMIT 1001

queries.name: fx
queries.sql: WITH x AS (SELECT rate_date,currency_code,rate_to_cny,source,note,created_at,updated_at,dense_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY currency_code ORDER BY rate_date DESC) AS date_rank FROM public.fx_rate_daily WHERE currency_code=ANY(%s) AND rate_date<=%s::date) SELECT * FROM x WHERE date_rank=1 ORDER BY currency_code LIMIT 11

queries.name: currencies
queries.sql: SELECT code,name_zh,is_active FROM public.fx_currency WHERE code=ANY(%s) ORDER BY code LIMIT 11

queries.name: hk_master
queries.sql: SELECT ts_code,market,exchange,list_date,delist_date,updated_at FROM stock_selector.stock_meta WHERE ts_code=ANY(%s) ORDER BY ts_code LIMIT 101

queries.name: hkd_edb_catalog
queries.sql: SELECT edb_code,series_name,min(trade_date) AS first_date,max(trade_date) AS last_date,count(*) AS rows FROM stock_selector.edb_daily WHERE series_name ~* %s AND trade_date<=%s::date GROUP BY edb_code,series_name ORDER BY edb_code LIMIT 101

queries.name: ec_lifecycle_case_check
queries.sql: SELECT symbol,variety,exchange,listing_date,last_trade_date,created_at,updated_at FROM public.futures_contracts_all WHERE upper(symbol)=%s ORDER BY symbol LIMIT 21

queries.name: asset_metadata
queries.sql: SELECT symbol,asset_type,exchange,contract_multiplier,tick_size,listing_date,expiry_date,is_active,updated_at,metadata->>'currency' AS currency,metadata->>'quote_currency' AS quote_currency,metadata->>'board_lot' AS board_lot,metadata->>'lot_size' AS lot_size,metadata->>'quote_unit' AS quote_unit FROM public.assets WHERE symbol=ANY(%s) ORDER BY symbol LIMIT 201

queries.name: rule_catalog_columns
queries.sql: SELECT table_schema,table_name,column_name,data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema NOT IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema') AND (column_name ~* %s OR (table_schema='exchange_data' AND table_name ~* %s)) ORDER BY table_schema,table_name,ordinal_position LIMIT 1001
